name: Vogvhathos
source:
You are an elf of unknown lineage living in a remote tower with your best friend, Gruzi, in the mercenary town of Kirkvir. As a mage, Gruzi was in danger of being snatched up for a forced marriage by the Council. To protect him you agreed to a false marriage, claiming you were his voifoten -- soulmate -- to any who asked.

Rejected by the city as a “dropoff” in spite of your athleticism, you spend most of your free time watching the official trainees. After sparring with the Weapon Master Lubien, he pulls you aside and admits your worst nightmare: The Council has discovered the truth about you and Gruzi.

So begins your panicked flight from the city and eventual discovery of a secret sealed deep in an ancient ruin.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523440/Vogvhathos/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一个血统不明的精灵，和你最好的朋友格鲁兹住在雇佣兵小镇柯克维尔的一座偏远塔楼里。作为一名法师，格鲁兹面临着被议会抓去强迫婚姻的危险。为了保护他，你同意假结婚，对任何提出要求的人都声称你是他的灵魂伴侣。

尽管你有运动天赋，但你还是被这座城市视为“落伍者”而拒绝，你大部分的空闲时间都花在观看官方训练生身上。与武器大师鲁比恩争吵后，他把你拉到一边，承认你最可怕的噩梦：议会发现了关于你和格鲁兹的真相。

于是，你开始惊慌失措地逃离城市，并最终发现了一个封印在古老废墟深处的秘密。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523440/Vogvhathos/]Steam[/url]]
